  Wendy: Hi, it's Wendy from SearchPie. 

Thank you for sharing. We really appreciate the insights. Our team will further research high-quality and relevant directories, and we will get back to you shortly with our findings.

In the meantime, could you please provide us with your logo following these requirements:
* Preferred format: PNG
* Background: Clean white background
* Recommended size: At least 500 x 500 px
* Aspect ratio: 1:1 (square) is the safest option
* File size: Ideally under 2 MB
* Quality: The logo should be sharp, not blurry, not compressed, and not stretched

Kindly share the logo via Google Drive to ensure the best quality.

Thank you in advance!

Best regards,
Wendy.

Lucas

Thanks a lot for your reply. I will inform Julie about your info~

Rest assured that she will work on it once she's back to work and update you as soon as possible!

Warm regards,
